groups.title: Chest GUI Core Infrastructure
groups.verdict: Chest GUI testing is retired; active screen replacements belong in G27 and admin resource-pack controls belong in G22.

groups.title: HUD System & ESC Integration
groups.verdict: All in-scope HUD/ESC features confirmed; bulk-lock padlock live-push fix confirmed in-game.

groups.title: Messages & Command Communication
groups.verdict: All Group 04 communication work is confirmed in-game.

groups.title: Silent Resource Pack Delivery
groups.verdict: Slow-internet joins, weak-PC textures, safe delivery, 2 GB stability, and old-version warnings are all built and awaiting play-testing (§D fix awaiting retest).

groups.title: Tools, Colour Variants & Per-Face Paint
groups.verdict: Reopened 2026-07-25: a deleted block could lose the picture it was made from. Fixed, needs the four D2 runs. Everything else stays confirmed; §E scrapped.

groups.title: Bulk Operations
groups.verdict: The two backend items are confirmed; re-id has just moved out of chat into the Workbench and needs an in-game check.

groups.title: Shape System & Per-Face Textures
groups.verdict: All built shape/per-face texture features confirmed in-game, including in-hand/inventory shaped icons. Vanilla block-behavior parity remains parked pending a design session.

groups.title: Backup, Data Safety & Trash
groups.verdict: All shipped sections (A, B, C, G, H, I) confirmed in-game. Cloud backup (old §F) dropped — backups are local-only now.

groups.title: Color & Image Tools
groups.verdict: Owner test 2026-07-28: penguin, stripes, subscribe and the golden pair pass; a pale outline survives on cut-out art and the football regressed.

groups.title: Category System
groups.verdict: Sections A and B are confirmed; C and E are built and waiting on one in-game round of 14 rows.

groups.title: Export Dashboard & Marketplace
groups.verdict: Offline export and Blueprint logic exist; remote download links, Vault sharing, Marketplace, importfolder, and advanced formats still need work.

groups.title: Arabic Backend
groups.verdict: Legacy Arabic behavior was confirmed; the real-SlotBlock rebuild retest and the new duplicate-number cleanup both still need an in-game check.

groups.title: Animation, Video & Display Blocks
groups.verdict: Basic animated blocks are confirmed; GIF retexture safety, render quality, source recovery, and display-block features remain open.

groups.title: AI Texture Generation
groups.verdict: The AI studio tab exists, but it still needs real in-game confirmation and a provider pivot before it is dependable.

groups.title: Diagnostics, IT Screen & Private Testing Center
groups.verdict: Diagnostics has strong historical coverage, but Debug Log retest, screen migration, and the private Testing Center are still open.

groups.title: Command Regressions
groups.verdict: Owned command regressions are confirmed; only the search Screen migration remains as a G27 handoff.

groups.title: Block Lore Notes
groups.verdict: Lore data and commands are partly built, but the Screen version and fresh owner confirmation are still missing.

groups.title: Showcase & Hologram Display Systems
groups.verdict: Showcase and hologram systems are fully designed, but implementation still needs to start with the core slice.

groups.title: Cloud Vault, Discord & External Integrations
groups.verdict: Block vault sharing is confirmed; backup R2 setup, conflict screen, Discord, Vault Hub, and signing remain open.

groups.title: Config Sync Backend
groups.verdict: The `max_blocks` self-heal is confirmed for lower clients; the higher-client no-op row still needs a clean run.

groups.title: Permissions System
groups.verdict: Permissions are parked with the main rules decided; the full command tier map still needs owner review before build.

groups.title: Player Experience, Onboarding & Achievements
groups.verdict: Screen-free onboarding and achievement engine are confirmed; sample blocks and G27 screen handoff still need clean coverage.

groups.title: Macros
groups.verdict: Macro toggle is confirmed; record/play, single-undo, and G27 screen handoff still need clean current coverage.

groups.title: Block Management Extras & Identity Operations
groups.verdict: ReID command core is confirmed; the case fix, ReID Screen, universal target shortcuts, and extras remain open.

groups.title: Name, Give & Named-Texture Mirror Fixes
groups.verdict: All four fixes are built, but each needs a fresh owner retest before it can return to confirmed.

groups.title: Unified Screens, Create Studio & Editing
groups.verdict: Studio baseline exists; new upgrades, shared browser filters, Editing/Text tabs, category Screens, and the wider screen migration still need owner tests or build work.

groups.title: Undo System Rework
groups.verdict: Undo command behavior is usable, but the visual undo/history UI is broken and needs the designed full rework.

groups.title: Creator / Capture Tools
groups.verdict: Native overlay and first Studio slice are built, but OBS invisibility, custom marks, and multiplayer push remain open.

groups.title: Guess Mode
groups.verdict: All earlier Guess Mode work is confirmed; Placed Mask Mode is now built and needs its first in-game run.

groups.title: BuzzerGame
groups.verdict: Screen text, stand outline, stopwatch flow, and per-part resize are built and awaiting owner retest; buzzer, wand session, and FX are confirmed.

groups.title: Explosive Tomato
groups.verdict: Tomato fly, boom, and interception are confirmed; mess/combat still have five regression rows (D1/D3/D13/E6/E8) plus parked mesh/QoL work.

groups.title: CB Control Center
groups.verdict: The CB Control Center is fully planned and parked; SRBProjects, presence, revocation, red-X enforcement, live updates, and emergency controls still need building.

groups.title: Wheel of Fortune
groups.verdict: Wheel face is now ONE baked texture instead of ~850 quads — seams cannot step or flicker, and the back reads mirrored. Re-place the wheel and re-check §A.

nextTask.action: In singleplayer, quickly create and re-texture two blocks using image links.
nextTask.expect: All textures show up, nothing looks broken, and you don't need to rejoin.
